Desks factored in emergency rate hikes by the Bank of Japan and subsequent yen weakness.
Primary dealers absorbed short-term liquidity through variable rate reverse repo auctions.
European refiners secured alternative spot crude shipments following pipeline attacks.
questions.e: Market participants actively tracked gains and priced potential trade policy outcomes ahead of the diplomatic Trump-Xi summit. The incorrect choices credit the equity futures move to Japanese monetary policy, Indian repo operations, or Middle Eastern supply disruptions.

questions.q: What price trajectory followed the initial public offering gains of Chinese robot maker Unitree?
o: Shares declined 55% from their peak valuation as early momentum reversed into harsher market realities.
The stock surged past 2 trillion yuan in daily market turnover driven by real estate sector rotation.
Equities recorded a 2.7% pre-market advance on Xetra prior to regular trading hours.
The company was automatically integrated into the Nasdaq 100 at a 2.8% capitalization weighting.
questions.e: Unitree shares dropped 55% from their peak, completely erasing initial post-IPO gains under prevailing market conditions. The distractors falsely link the stock to total Chinese market turnover, German exchange pre-markets, or US index weightings.
